hooks.name: Postman API Testing

action.prompt: API/config saved. Do not run Postman collections or tests automatically. For an explicit Postman request, inspect root .postman.json first; if missing or empty, explain and ask before creating resources; verify referenced IDs; never duplicate without confirmation; use Postman MCP only; validate Collection Format v2.1.0. Otherwise do not activate Postman.

hooks.description: Routes explicit Postman work without automatically running collections or tests.
